topics.topic: Market Segmentation: Meaning, bases of segmentation (geographic, demographic, psychographic, behavioral)
learningObjectives: Define market segmentation and state criteria for effective segmentation (measurable, accessible, substantial)
Segment Nigerian consumer markets by age, gender, income, religion, and urban/rural location
Explain target marketing strategies: undifferentiated, differentiated, and concentrated marketing

topics.topic: Market Research: Meaning, importance, and stages in the marketing research process
learningObjectives: Explain the role of market research in reducing commercial decision risk
Detail research stages: defining problem, developing research plan, data collection, analysis, reporting
Differentiate between primary research (surveys, focus groups) and secondary data sources

topics.topic: Marketing Information System (MIS): Internal records, marketing intelligence, and decision support
learningObjectives: Define Marketing Information System (MIS) and identify its four core subsystems
Explain how internal sales records and customer feedback shape marketing strategy
Examine legal and ethical methods of gathering competitor marketing intelligence

topics.topic: Channels of Distribution (Place Mix): Channels for consumer and industrial products
learningObjectives: Map distribution pathways: direct marketing (zero-level), one-level (retailer), and two-level (wholesaler)
Analyze intermediary functions: sorting, accumulation, allocation, financing, and risk-taking
Examine causes of channel conflict (vertical and horizontal) and conflict resolution techniques

topics.topic: Wholesaling and Retailing in Nigeria: Traditional markets and modern supermarkets
learningObjectives: Differentiate between merchant wholesalers, brokers, and manufacturers' sales branches
Examine retail formats in Nigeria: open markets (Balogun, Onitsha, Bodija), mom-and-pop kiosks, supermarkets
Analyze trends in modern shopping malls, franchise retailing, and cashless retail payments

topics.topic: Promotion Mix: Advertising, sales promotion, public relations, and direct marketing
learningObjectives: Identify components of the integrated promotion mix and their specific marketing roles
Explain the AIDA model (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action) in advertising campaigns
Compare above-the-line mass media advertising with below-the-line direct promotional activations

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Marketing Campaign Simulation
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of market segmentation, distribution channels, and the promotion mix
Evaluate student design of an advertising copy and poster for a youth-targeted consumer product
Provide remedial coaching on the distinction between advertising and publicity

topics.topic: Advertising Media: Broadcast, print, outdoor billboard, and digital internet channels
learningObjectives: Evaluate merits and limitations of television, radio, newspapers, magazines, and billboards
Analyze criteria for media selection: target audience reach, frequency, lead time, and cost per thousand (CPM)
Examine statutory regulations enforced by the Advertising Regulatory Council of Nigeria (ARCON)

topics.topic: Sales Promotion and Merchandising: Contests, coupons, discounts, premiums, and POS displays
learningObjectives: Define sales promotion as short-term incentives to stimulate immediate purchase
Examine consumer-oriented promotions: buy-one-get-one-free, scratch cards, loyalty rewards
Explore trade-oriented promotions: dealer allowances, push money, and eye-level shelf placement

topics.topic: Public Relations and Corporate Sponsorship: Building positive institutional image
learningObjectives: Define Public Relations (PR) and explain how it differs from paid commercial advertising
Analyze tools of corporate PR: press releases, press conferences, community social responsibility (CSR)
Examine corporate sponsorship of sports leagues and educational quiz competitions in Nigeria

topics.topic: Warehousing and Physical Distribution: Logistics, inventory management, and transport choices
learningObjectives: Explain the strategic role of warehousing in stabilizing supply and prices of seasonal commodities
Compare public, private, and customs-bonded warehouses in commercial ports
Evaluate transport modes (road, rail, water, air, pipelines) regarding speed, capacity, and cost

topics.topic: Comprehensive SSS 2 Marketing Termly Revision & Case Study Drill
learningObjectives: Synthesize concepts across market research, channel management, promotion mix, and logistics
Practice answering past WASSCE Paper 2 essay questions involving marketing dilemmas
Refine student capability in interpreting marketing data charts and consumer surveys
Administer standardized SSS 2 Marketing theory and objective examination
Grade scripts in accordance with WAEC rubric guidelines and marking schemes
Record and publish official continuous assessment and examination results
